record.oneLiner: GoHighLevel is a CRM and marketing automation platform offering a broad REST API authenticated via OAuth 2.0 and Private Integration Tokens, with an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
record.verdictReason: GoHighLevel provides comprehensive public REST API documentation on its developer portal supporting OAuth 2.0 and API integration tokens, accessible on self-serve plans, and even offers an official MCP server.

evidence.quote: HighLevel supports: Private Integration Tokens for internal or single-location integrations, OAuth 2.0 for public integrations and Marketplace apps requiring user authorization
Q. Is API access available on all HighLevel plans? API access varies by plan: Starter & Unlimited: Basic API access
